eligibility.evidence: Sec 3.1-3.5, 4: GPT-2-Large-sized models are trained from scratch on filtered corpora (9 models) and probed with self-built minimal-pair grammaticality tests from theoretical syntax, plus perplexity, attention and cosine-similarity analyses. No cognitive-experimental paradigm is administered to a pretrained LLM, no human data; E2 and E1 not met (borderline: psycholinguistics-adjacent).

A.title: Exposure is Optional: Learning Unlike Coordination in Language Models

G.notes: Models are trained by the authors from scratch (filtered-corpus training), so they are not pretrained models under test; evaluation is linguistic-theory minimal pairs and internal-representation analysis. Referee may ask whether theoretical-syntax grammaticality tests count as psycholinguistic paradigms (E2). B, C, E left empty per NO rule.
